Introduction

Jayn Lee, also known as Jaeyun, is a South Korean singer-songwriter under HYPEER Records and was the leader of the boy group TO1. After participating in the 2019 survival show World Klass, he debuted with TO1 in April 2020.

Following TO1's disbandment in December 2023, Jaeyun signed with HYPEER Records in June 2024 and announced the he would make his solo debut, under the stage name Jayn Lee, with the EP "zzZ", releasing on July 4, 2024, with the pre-release of the single "Say Yes" on June 21.
